text: MessageListTracker passes its current approval callback into each new MessageList and its current criteria callback into each new MessageQuery. Those objects retain the captured callbacks. Their invocation is gated by Cu.isInAutomation; MessageQuery keeps its real criteria method as the default. Changing the tracker hook later does not replace a callback already captured by an existing object. Keep hook reset and object completion separate in this harness. No test-hook or cancellation execution was performed.
title: Pagination automation hooks are captured by each new list and query
